description: Judge a price someone was quoted or already paid for one sailing: whether it is low, typical or high against that sailing's usual price for the cabin, today's listed fare beside it, the lowest fare read in 120 days, a plain one-paragraph answer to quote, and watch_url where the person can be emailed if the fare drops below their price. Name the sailing by sailing_id, a fantasize.net /cruise/ link, or ship plus depart_date.

cabin.description: Cabin grade to price. Omit to quote balcony where sold, else the next grade.

price.description: The quoted or paid fare in USD, per person for the whole cruise, taxes and port fees in

price_is_for_two.description: true if price is the total for a cabin of two

ship.description: Or the ship name ("Celebrity Beyond") with depart_date

url.description: Or a fantasize.net /cruise/ link, or a Cruisebound sailing link

name: check_price
title: Is this cruise price good?
